calibration.calibrated_reading: every native class at 0, 1 and 10 times its own w_cal
calibration.definition: w_cal(class) = time(one native operation of the class) / time(one group addition of the arm's own group), same host and process

host.isolation: none: shared VM, other processes may run

calibration.method: best-of-N timing (not perf-ipc; no isolated host): minimum over batches of ns per operation
